summary: Business analytics professional with ~7 years partnering with senior stakeholders at asset managers, pension funds, and consulting firms to turn complex data into decisions -- directly aligned with the Director, Business Analytics and Insights mandate. Led the design of an enterprise analytics engine, re-engineered manual spreadsheet reporting into audited Python pipelines, and built agentic AI workflows that cut development cycle time an estimated 30-40%. CFA charterholder with dual MSc degrees; track record of independently-reviewed analytical output trusted across roughly $50bn of institutional client portfolios.

sections.heading: Business Analytics & Insight Delivery
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, converting a manual process into a repeatable analytics capability across institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement.
Architected configurable time-bucketed analytics (T+1 through multi-year) that gave client investment teams forward-looking funding and liquidity insight to guide allocation decisions.

Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level data into portfolio-level risk and performance metrics -- the analytics equivalent of KPI reporting -- delivered to client Heads of Risk and downstream reporting processes.

sections.heading: AI Enablement, Automation & Rapid Prototyping
bullets: Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation - reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet reporting workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls, improving data quality and consistency of outputs.

Prototyped replacement pipelines in parallel with live delivery, ran them in shadow mode for two reporting cycles, reconciled results, and cut over with a rollback plan - a pattern reused across adjacent workflows.

sections.heading: Stakeholder Partnership & Executive Communication
bullets: Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into investment-committee-ready narratives.
Served as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders to resolve and remediate.
Mentored junior colleagues and acted as senior reviewer within a 12-person modelling services team, setting the review standard applied before client release.

sections.heading: Model & Data Governance, Controls & Quality
bullets: Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement, ~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing methodology and assumptions before production release.
Member of the model governance committee - contributed to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms.
Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, scoping business requirements into prioritized development requests and validating outputs post-deployment.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning reporting requirements with system implementation.
Coordinated cross-functional actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness materials.

Delivered analytics studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, quantifying funding ratio, duration, and long-horizon exposures to inform strategic allocation decisions.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and attribution to test the robustness of recommendations.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Presented findings and recommendations on-site to investment committees at pension-fund clients, including the onboarding and study for a three-plan university pension merger.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
